overview.description: The Calamos Russell 2000 Structured Alt Protection ETF January (CPRY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund seeks to track the return of the iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM), to a cap, with 100% downside hedge over a one year outcome period. The actively managed fund holds FLEX options to obtain exposure CPRY was launched on Jan 2, 2025 and is issued by Calamos.

data.title: Calamos Announces Upside Cap Rates for CPSY and CPRY: Structured Protection ETFs Providing Exposure to S&P 500 and Russell 2000 with 100% Downside Protection Over One Year
